mode: Independent source, SQL contract, test and existing log review; no tests executed by reviewer; no product edits.
verdict_scope: No remaining concrete P1/P2 finding in the bounded message identity and save reconciliation diff at the listed hashes. This is not a production or whole-system certification.

checks.criterion: The same message UUID is retained before the uncertain INSERT and reused for a retry of the same local user turn.
Only a successful INSERT or an exact row matching id, conversation_id, role, content and owner can mark the turn confirmed.
401, 403 and 42501 definitive refusals are not reconciled, whether returned or thrown; duplicate 23505 and bounded classes of ambiguous transport errors may be read back.
Signal checks after INSERT and SELECT plus lease.current before fetch prevent late reconciliation from admitting an old request after cancellation or account/conversation change.
Assistant message persistence uses its existing UI UUID, and a received answer is retained without automatic regeneration on unknown persistence.
Existing SQL primary key and owner-only SELECT/INSERT RLS support this read-back strategy without an UPDATE, upsert, or policy change.

browser_local_attempt.reason: Playwright Chromium executable missing; all three fail during browser launch.

limitations: The React database fixture models commit, lost acknowledgement and primary-key conflict; it is not a live PostgreSQL/PostgREST or RLS execution proof.
Browser scenarios were reviewed but not qualified locally because browser launch was blocked; CI outcome remains separate.
The preserved retry identity lives in the mounted widget; page reload recovery and conversation-creation idempotency are outside this change.
No production migration state, actual model calls, deployment or account isolation in a remote database was verified by this review.
